notes.title: Trading Cards and a short status update
notes.notes:
Hello there,

An unusually long time passed since the last Card Hog update and the next one is taking longer than I expected, so I wanted to apologize for that and get you up to date.

The main and most unfortunate reason of this delay was my lack of motivation likely caused by a mix of burnout, health issues and just plain ol' mental exhaustion. No need to worry, everything is okay-ish now and I'm making some progress with gamedev work again! 

However, I didn't want to follow up my absence with a tiny "bug fixes and UI improvements" update, took a chunky task of adding custom games and reworking deck creation, so it's taking a while... First iteration of custom games will allow players to modify a bunch of game options to tweak difficulty and certain mechanics. But my idea for the future is to add support for basic custom scenarios (spawn x card every y turns, etc). 

Ideally, I'd like to move the game out of Early Access in the first quarter of 2022, but there still are a few big tasks I need to finish for that to happen. Mainly creating end game content for zombies and loops.

Talking about big tasks... ːchslimeː

[h2]Trading Cards![/h2]

Did you notice any new items in your inventory? Trading Cards are finally here, so good luck collecting the sets! Hope you like the designs, [url=https://twitter.com/EmiliusDraws]Emil[/url] did a fantastic job on those characters and I find all of them adorable! Which one is your favorite?

There might be more emotes and Point Store stickers added in the future, so also let me know what you'd like to see there!

That's about it for now. Sorry for the lack of updates and I hope to talk to you soon!

Cheers!

SnoutUp

notes.title: Sandbox mode, new boss and many small changes
notes.notes:
Hello there,

If you have been following smaller and sneakier update posts, you can probably skip this one. However, I would like to bring more attention to the Sandbox mode as it's been getting more advanced and more comfortable to use.

[h1]Sandbox[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36134752/ac708943f2721bd7680c2674497082a0c59cdbf1.png[/img]
The latest major addition has been a Sandbox mode, which you can find in the Workshop tab. It's a playground where you're free to try out all kinds of card combinations and scenarios, maybe train fighting against a boss you've been struggling with or attempt to reproduce a bug you've discovered in the wild.

[h2]Sandbox controls[/h2]

Mouse click to place a card in a hovered context (grid location, queue or deck), CTRL+ click to remove it from the context. Hover a card property (corner where health or damage is) and use scroll to change that value.

These are likely to change in the future and suggestions for improvements are very welcome!

[h2]Sandbox changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Adding cards to a spawn queue is now an option[/b]
[*] Merchant inventory is now reset every time Sandbox restarts
[*] Card deck is now viewable in Sandbox mode

[*] Card values are now always visible in edit mode
[*] Fixed a bug where multiple cards could be removed from deck/queue by a single click
[*] Fixed multiple issues with multiple hogs
[*] Fixed certain cards (moles, mimics) starting the Sandbox play session in visually active state
[*] Fixed a bug where player dying would break the Sandbox
[*] Fixed a bug which allowed placing cards while certain menus (game over, deck) were present
[*] Fixed a bug where (sometimes invisible) card list would make a part of grid inactive

[/list]

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]

[*] Being sneeze-knockebacked into a trap won't shift whole column/row of cards with character anymore
[*] Weapons are now properly visually scaled depending on the character icon scale
[*] Fixed a bug where deck counter was always zero in some modes
[*] Fixed a bug where unlocking new card from the loadout while in town or other secondary location would add that card to the wrong deck
[*] Added a note about Foxhole perk lowering explosion damage from the Bombi

[h2]Final notes[/h2]

I'd love to hear some feedback from people who already discovered and tried out playing online coop mode. Should I keep working on that? And all kinds of feedback in general would be great. Maybe leave a review if you have time! Helps the game a lot. Also, Trading Cards are being worked on.

notes.title: Spawn holes, massive bug fixed and balance changes
notes.notes:
Hello there,

Before I'll tell you about a massive bug which plagued the game for months and was only fixed in the latest update, I want to say... I'm really sorry. It was quite something! ːlunar2019piginablanketː

[h1]Big Bug[/h1]

Basically, for the shamefully long time killing an enemy with a body attack... would sometimes remove that enemy from the deck of the run! It was hard to notice in the heat of the run and likely resulted in many runs being way easier than they should've been as well as caused a bunch of weird bugs like enemies stopping to spawn in Zombie Survival or side quests taking way too long. Also some people got insane scores and complained about the game being too easy... And sometimes it was, but I didn't know why!

So this should be fixed now and I might add an in-game option to reset highscores. It's also likely that all of the game modes will be a bit harder now, so let me know if balance update is needed.

[h1]Spawn Holes[/h1]

On to the next big thing... A better one, I hope! I always wanted to give players more control over their run and strengthen deck building part of the game. So, let me present to you... Spawn Holes! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jQUpWWn.gif[/img]

From now on these cards will start spawning in the Dungeon Loops to replace game adding random enemies to your deck. Instead hogs will be able to get to the holes and choose (spot) the enemy in advance. Gotta be fast, because if timer runs out - completely random enemy will be added to the deck AND it also spawns on the board.

At the moment it only works with basic enemy types, but depending on the feedback I might connect this to the elite-level enemies too. I think this changes the game quite a bit, but let me know what you think about this addition!

[h2]Major Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a massive bug where body kills would remove enemies from the deck
[*] New card: Spawn Hole
[/list]
[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Rewritten multiplayer input code which should make it more stable
[*] Preventing saving & leaving while targeting a skill which was causing rare soft-locks
[*] Fixed a bug where loading game while in mind-control would soft-lock the game
[*] Fixed a bug where second player card would spawn in single player modes
[*] Added some missing translations
[/list]
Alright, that's it for now. I'm STILL working on new characters. A little bit stuck with those, but it's my top priority right now, so worst case scenario I'll release some with temporary perks/cards and ask for better ideas from you! 

Cheers!

SnoutUp

notes.title: Update, year recap and 2021 roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello there,

In this post I'm going to briefly recap the Card Hog Early Access journey so far, tell you about things I plan to add this year and list the changes made in the last few silent updates. But before all that I would like to ask one question...

[h3]What would [b]YOU[/b] like to see in Card Hog this year?[/h3]

Anything goes! I really want to hear what are you looking forward to and what kind of crazy ideas you have. Who knows, maybe I'll implement a thing you suggested sooner or like a new idea enough to add it to the game ASAP!

[h2]Card Hog in 2020[/h2]

Last year was pretty wild for all the world, but for Card Hog it was... okay-ish. Release in June went better than I expected, but things quickly calmed down and lately we're just slowly cruising towards the full release when Steam will hopefully increase game visibility in various lists and it starts getting more sales.

However, I'm quite optimistic about the future since the reception of this little card crawler has been mind-blowingly positive and I can't thank you enough for that. It keeps my motivation sky high!

[list]
[*] 28 weeks of early access
[*] 23 updates (almost weekly)
[*] 243 reviews (all positive!!!)
[*] 67 average daily users (last 7 days)
[*] 1h 10min median time played
[*] 376 remote play sessions (there's multiplayer!)
[*] ~800 free keys activated (I like giveaways)
[*] 0.8% players unlocked "Say Cheese!" achievement
[/list]

Initially I was hoping that Early Access would take no more than 6 months, but we're past that deadline already (classic) and there's still so much I want to do, so... It will take a bit longer. Not sure how long, but I'll try to make sure that you wouldn't get bored... Talking about it..

[h2]Plans for 2021[/h2]

My TODO list is an absolute mess and I occasionally like to chase "a crazy new idea", but here are a few things I'm either already working on or plan to work on during the next few months:

[list]
[*] Seeded challenges with leaderboards
[*] Translations
[*] Workshop for custom weapons and possibly enemies
[*] Better score and highscore system
[*] End game for zombie survival mode
[*] Better end game (and better name) for loops 
[*] Final epic boss fight
[*] Secondary perks
[*] Multiple ways to use beans during the run
[*] New characters
[*] Character bios
[*] Trading Cards and other Steam goodies
[*] New cards and combos for existing cards (obviously)
[*] Release of Android (F2P) and iOS (premium) versions
[/list]

But wait, there will be more!

I talked about adding story before, but I want to write a better quest system first and I'm using Zombie mode to test things out, so that will take much longer and might be something I want to do last or even after full release (not a DLC, just a big content update). However, more random NPCs with new types of quests will start appearing in endless game modes sooner.

What else... oh, yeah! Update!

notes.title: Zombie survival, crafting and balance changes
notes.notes:
Hello there,

No time for long intros, since I have quite a few new things to show you! In short, there's a new game mode (called HOG Z for now) for you to try out, so update Card Hog and give it a go!

[h2]HOG Z[/h2]

In a nutshell Hog Z is a survival mode in which hogs scavenge for resources and fight zombies while regularly visiting "safe house" to craft (!) weapons and other cards. I'm trying out quite a few new things with it, so any kind of feedback would be great! 

[h3]Crafting[/h3]

Crafting stations will be available in Hog Z "safe houses" and to avoid flooding decks with multiple materials, stats like card pickups and kills are being used as crafting materials. Meaning that killing two moles and gathering 20 scrap is enough to create a shovel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36134752/3f495c6504525526a40e36fd70a5341e1a98f3b9.png[/img]

But wouldn't hoarding scrap and crafting a bunch of cheap items (like crowbars) throw deck balance out of the window? Ah, well...

[h3]Card Uses[/h3]

As you probably noticed some of the cards in Card Hog that appear on the board don't go back to the deck to spawn again later. That is done to avoid over-crowding the decks, but felt limiting for a lot what I'd like to do, so in Hog Z I'm introducing "multi-use" deck cards, which open up some interesting possibilities!

For example, crafting a card will add it to the deck and crafting same card again will increase its use counter! Adds a bit more strategy to this new mode. 

[h2]Major Things[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hog Z game mode
[*] Card Crafting
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed broken drop weights making certain cards (boomerang) much less frequent
[*] Removed one spider from the starting deck of the loops mode
[*] Added a bonus weapon (Stick) to the loops deck to help out new runs
[/list]

[h2]Other Things[/h2]
[list]
[*] Moles now dig out empty spots if they attack them
[*] Projectiles shouldn't lock controls anymore
[*] Added a workaround for unkillable 0 health enemies (made them killable until I can find the cause)
[*] Increased game saving and loading speed
[*] Added a saving indicator
[*] Improved skill target indicators
[*] Added auto-save after player moves between grids
[*] Pressing ESC in Game Over should switch to game mode list
[*] Fixed buggy mole targeting when it gets dug out with a shovel
[*] Fixed mimic spawning visually revealed 
[*] Fixed enemy targets not being visible after loading the game
[*] Fixed some beans not being awarded after badge unlocks (some might get free beans from that)
[*] Fixed slimed items being invisible 
[*] Slightly nicer skill/perk ribbons and fixes to their positioning
[*] Nicer lasso image
[/list]

There's probably more, but that's for you to discover! Let me know what you think about the new game mode, meanwhile I'll keep expanding it.

And I'm aware that there's still no use for bean overflow! ːlunar2019piginablanketː

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/EpdZqS6

Cheers!

But being anxious can wait (haha, I wish!), since I got a lot of great feedback already and had to roll out an update which should improve your experience with the game and keep you busy until new content arrives! 

[h2]Balance[/h2]

I might've went a bit too hard on this, but blame the streamers who managed to "beat" the endless modes and were not able to reach their end. It hurt to watch, so now it's my turn ːlunar2019piginablanketː

[*] Lowered damage of the Skullington by 1

This isn't ideal, but should make longer runs harder, bosses challenging without hurting early game too much. There will be major changes in certain game systems, so things will shift around in the future. Let me know what you think.
